waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it.

mutations.name: observe-forgets-session
mutations.why: #observeResponse no longer takes the session get_state names: a crash or a restart after the first answer comes back on a new session (the bug a10eb6877 fixed).
mutations.search: /\ path' = IF OldCode THEN path ELSE onOmp

mutations.name: restart-forgets-session
mutations.why: restart() with no session drops the tab's session again (machine setup, the desktop slot).
mutations.search:
/\ path' = IF OldCode THEN NoS ELSE path
    /\ UNCHANGED <<isNew, written, lastOpen, used, spawns, shown, moved>>
mutations.replace:
/\ path' = NoS
    /\ UNCHANGED <<isNew, written, lastOpen, used, spawns, shown, moved>>

mutations.name: unwritten-session-left-to-autoresume
mutations.why: sessionOpen leaves a tab whose session stock has not written to omp's default: autoResume may put it on another conversation.
mutations.search: ELSE IF n \/ p # NoS THEN [k |-> "new"]

mutations.name: session-without-written-check
mutations.why: sessionOpen passes --session on a file stock never wrote ("Session not found").
mutations.search: IF p # NoS /\ p \in w THEN [k |-> "session", f |-> p]
mutations.replace: IF p # NoS THEN [k |-> "session", f |-> p]

mutations.name: new-cleared-at-ready
mutations.why: F1 as shipped in a10eb6877: #isNew cleared at ready, so an omp that crashes before its get_state answer leaves the next spawn to autoResume.
mutations.search: /\ isNew' = IF ClearNewAt = "ready" THEN FALSE ELSE isNew
